exposure: mifepristone (200 mg orally) followed by vaginal misoprostol (100 ug per vaginal for <37 weeks gestation, 50 ug for >37 weeks gestation or previous LSCS)
cohort: The study included 70 women with late intrauterine fetal demise, randomized into two groups for induction of labor.
finding: The combined regimen of mifepristone and misoprostol significantly reduced the mean induction-to-delivery interval compared to dinoprostone gel alone, proving to be a more effective, less invasive, and safer option.
gest_age: Patients with late intrauterine fetal demise, with misoprostol dosing adjusted for those less than 37 weeks of gestation and those more than 37 weeks of gestational age.
